how_to_measure: Put on the biometric wristband.
Sit still and breathe normally for 3 minutes.
hr_rest.why_check: A rising resting heart rate is an early sign of stress, fatigue, or illness.

how_to_measure: Wear the chest strap overnight.
Sync the data to the app when you wake up.
hrv_rmssd.why_check: Heart rate variability shows how well your body recovers from stress and exercise.

how_to_measure: Place the sensor on your index finger.
Wait 15 seconds for the reading to stabilize.
spo2.why_check: Checks if your lungs are moving enough oxygen into your blood.

how_to_measure: Wear the chest strap or wristband.
Breathe normally while at rest.
rr.why_check: High breathing rates can indicate high CO2 in the cabin or an incoming illness.

how_to_measure: Lie down for 5 minutes and record heart rate.
Stand up quickly and record heart rate for 1 minute.
DRAFT: Perform only in gravity environments.
stand_hr_rise.why_check: Tests how well your heart responds to gravity, showing if you are dehydrated or dizzy.

how_to_measure: Wrap the cuff around your bare upper arm.
Keep your arm at heart level and press start.
bp_sys.why_check: Measures the maximum pressure in your blood vessels. Important for tracking fluid shifts.

how_to_measure: Wrap the cuff around your bare upper arm.
Keep your arm at heart level and press start.
bp_dia.why_check: Measures the resting pressure in your blood vessels. Helps check heart health.

how_to_measure: Place the thermometer in your ear.
Press the button and wait for the beep.
temperature.why_check: A fever means your body is fighting an infection. Spaceflight can slightly raise normal body temp.

how_to_measure: Wash your hands.
Use the lancet to prick your finger.
Apply a drop of blood to the test strip.
glucose.why_check: Checks your blood sugar levels. Spaceflight can change how your body processes sugar.

how_to_measure: Wear the biometric wristband to bed.
Sync the device in the morning.
sleep_h.why_check: Good sleep is critical for quick thinking, mood, and immune health.

how_to_measure: Open the daily survey in the app.
Rate your mood on the 1-10 slider.
mood.why_check: Isolation and workload affect your mental health. Tracking helps catch burnout early.

how_to_measure: Open the daily survey in the app.
Rate your stress level on the 1-10 slider.
stress.why_check: High stress lowers immunity and makes mistakes more likely.

how_to_measure: Open the PVT app on the tablet.
Tap the screen as fast as possible when the light turns on.
Complete the 3-minute test.
pvt_median.why_check: Measures your reaction time to ensure you are alert enough for critical tasks.

how_to_measure: Counted automatically during your PVT test.
pvt_lapses.why_check: Tracks how many times you zoned out or reacted too slowly. High lapses mean severe fatigue.

how_to_measure: Log your water intake in the nutrition app.
Check your urine color against the chart in the waste unit.
hydration.why_check: Dehydration worsens dizziness, kidney stones, and fatigue.

how_to_measure: Log your resistive and aerobic exercise sessions in the app.
exercise.why_check: Daily exercise is the only way to stop severe bone and muscle loss in zero gravity.

how_to_measure: Use the space mass measurement device.
Follow the strap-in procedure and record the reading.
body_mass.why_check: Losing body mass means you are losing muscle, bone, or fluids. You must eat enough to maintain weight.
body_mass.equipment: Space linear acceleration mass measurement device

how_to_measure: Read the environmental monitor on the wall panel.
co2.why_check: High CO2 causes headaches, poor sleep, and slow thinking.

how_to_measure: Wear your personal dosimeter at all times.
Scan it weekly at the base station.
radiation_dose.why_check: Tracks your exposure to space radiation to keep you below dangerous lifetime limits.
